desc: GitHub #42 on 0.4.1 (the reference checkout): the battle's Change Partner list with seven partners, Goombella out. 0.4.1 drew each row's HP from the GameCube's 32-bit row layout (0x18 bytes, HP at 0x14) over the PC's 64-bit rows, so the numbers are other bytes of the rows (0/0, 1/0, pointer halves), not the partners' HP. A capture of the bug, for the report; 0.5.0 runs gh42_partner_hp
